hero.subhead: Our commitment doesn't end at project handover. BTEL provides nationwide, round-the-clock after-sales support ensuring reliable operation, timely service, and lasting customer confidence — for every solution we deliver.

services.heading: Five Pillars of After-Sales Excellence
services.intro: From planned maintenance to emergency response — BTEL's post-delivery service team is built to keep your systems running at peak performance.

cards.title: Unparalleled Technical Expertise
cards.description: Our service engineers are factory-trained on every solution BTEL delivers — from substation protection systems to solar inverters. You get the same expertise post-delivery as during installation.

cards.title: Embracing Commitments
cards.description: We safeguard every sale with extensive after-sales service coverage. AMC agreements, spare parts provisioning, and scheduled maintenance visits keep your assets in peak operating condition.

cards.title: Precision Engineering
cards.description: BTEL's service team pursues work perfection relentlessly — diagnosing root causes, not just symptoms. We close every ticket only when the client confirms satisfaction.

cards.title: 24/7 Effortless Vigilance
cards.description: Emergency calls receive immediate dispatch from our nearest field team. Service excellence is measured round the clock — nights, weekends, and public holidays included.

cards.title: Resolute Emergency Response
cards.description: Critical failures demand immediate action. BTEL's emergency response protocol ensures breakdowns are attended on the same day — preventing production loss and safety hazards.

cards.title: Annual Maintenance Contracts
cards.description: Planned, predictive, and preventive maintenance under structured AMC agreements — with defined SLAs, response times, and compliance reporting. Budget with certainty.

process.heading: Our Service Process
process.intro: From the moment you log a request to confirmed resolution — BTEL's service process is structured, transparent, and accountable.

steps.title: Log a Request
steps.description: Call, email, or fill the online form. Your request is logged immediately in our service system and acknowledged within 1 hour.

steps.title: Assessment & Dispatch
steps.description: A technical lead evaluates the issue and dispatches the right engineer with the right tools — within agreed response timelines.

steps.title: On-Site Resolution
steps.description: Our field engineer diagnoses, repairs, and tests to confirm full restoration. Emergency spare parts are stocked centrally for rapid deployment.

steps.title: Closure & Report
steps.description: A service report is issued confirming root cause, work done, and recommendations. Ticket closes only on client sign-off.

coverage.cardIntro: BTEL field engineers are positioned across Bangladesh's major industrial zones and cities — ensuring rapid response anywhere in the country.
coverage.intro: BTEL's service network covers all major industrial belts in Bangladesh — from the Dhaka Export Processing Zone to the Chittagong port industrial corridor and beyond.

points.title: Industrial Zones
points.description: All EPZs, SEZs, and private industrial parks. Our engineers are familiar with on-site protocols for multinational factory environments.

points.title: Solar Plant O&M
points.description: Scheduled operations and maintenance visits for all BTEL-installed solar plants — inverter checks, panel cleaning, string testing, and yield optimization.

points.title: Substation & Switchgear AMC
points.description: Preventive maintenance programs for 11kV/33kV substations, transformers, HV/LV panels, and SCADA systems — keeping your power infrastructure reliable.

cta.intro: Log a service request online, call our direct service line, or reach out for an AMC agreement.
